experiment_question: What does the registered legal-information interface and configured measurement noise do to the full-route run, and does the run pass its single-run audit?

fields.trajectory: state x0..x29: four vehicle poses and the payload pose in world coordinates
fields.error: payload error against the route interpolated at the recorded reference distance, projected onto the reference heading (D1 convention)
fields.force: four point-force norms, internal force norm, cumulative impulse from accepted substeps
fields.constraint: tyre utilisation curves at controller-tick endpoints; hard-gate extrema recomputed over accepted substeps and endpoints; payload support reported by the same convention
fields.input: requested versus actual steering, maximum and maximum difference
fields.cost: per-solve wall clock against the frozen 5 s budget

units: m, s, N, N s, deg, dimensionless utilisation
window: ticks 0..2378 of 2379; {'whole route' if complete else 'accepted segment only, unobserved remainder not drawn'}
statistics_convention: single trajectory, no confidence interval; force and constraint hard-gate extrema combine all accepted substeps and controller-tick endpoints; plotted tyre curves are endpoints
caption: R5 legal-information interface: 20260917_R5_STRICT_N0_GPU01, plant step 2 ms, COMPLETED. 2379 of 2379 ticks accepted, reference distance 95.128 m of 95.128 m. Substep peak point force 398.459 N against the 15000 N gate; all-sample peak tyre utilisation 0.049285; all-sample minimum support 4686.3 N; final payload position error 0.4428 m; single-run audit PASS_SINGLE_RUN_AUDIT.
claim_boundary: One deterministic information-interface run; it contains no network impairment and states no statistical robustness. Completion and physical hard gates do not override the recorded single-run audit status.

checks: PNG readable and uncropped at original resolution
run identity and COMPLETED 2379/2379 title correct
trajectory and error panels labelled with units
force broken axis and 15000 N gate correctly labelled
all-sample tyre and support extrema shown
footer displays PASS_SINGLE_RUN_AUDIT, steering bound, and solve-time statistics
visual_qa.note: Final rendering generated after PASS_SINGLE_RUN_AUDIT 35/35; PNG and SVG are the current deliverables.
